meta.name: affiliate-blog-builder
meta.description: Write SEO-optimized affiliate blog articles, product reviews, comparison posts, listicles, and how-to guides. Triggers on: "write a blog post about", "review of [product]", "best [category] article", "comparison blog", "affiliate blog", "SEO article", "write a review", "product roundup", "blog content for affiliate", "how to use [product] blog post", "listicle about [category]", "[product] vs [product] blog", "content for my affiliate site".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动撰写SEO优化的联盟营销博客文章
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果运营联盟营销网站，需要大量SEO优化的产品文章。
copy.tagline_en: Write SEO-optimized affiliate blog articles automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run an affiliate site and need SEO-optimized product articles at scale.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你撰写 SEO 优化的联盟营销博客文章，支持产品评测、对比、最佳列表和教程四种格式。文章包含关键词策略、结构化标题、对比表格、行动号召、FAQ 架构和 FTC 合规声明。
howto.when: 当你要求写博客、产品评测、对比文章、最佳列表或教程时触发，例如说“写一篇关于[产品]的博客”、“[产品]的评测”或“最佳[类别]文章”。

say.text: 写一篇关于HeyGen的详细评测
say.note: 会自动生成产品评测格式的博客
会生成对比文章，包含竞争对手搜索

say.text: 写一篇最佳AI视频工具列表文章
say.note: 会生成为列表格式，自动搜索同类产品

howto.what_en: Claude writes SEO-optimized affiliate blog articles in four formats: product review, comparison, listicle, and how-to guide. Each article includes keyword strategy, structured headings, comparison tables, CTAs, FAQ schema, and FTC-compliant disclosure.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to write a blog, product review, comparison, best-of listicle, or how-to guide, e.g., "write a blog post about [product]", "review of [product]", or "best [category] article".
